nodes.label: Faceless Video Pipeline
nodes.summary: A pipeline turning structured JSON chapter data into narrated, captioned YouTube videos with no stock footage or human faces.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Coordination
nodes.summary: Rules for AI agents working concurrently on the repo, each claiming a non-overlapping layer.

nodes.label: HTML/GSAP over Stock Footage
nodes.summary: Pixel-perfect, deterministic, reusable HTML/CSS/GSAP animation chosen over stock footage or MoviePy.

nodes.label: build-chapter.js
nodes.summary: Main CommonJS pipeline orchestrator that runs TTS, audio split, captions, render, concat, and upload.

nodes.label: whisper-captions.js
nodes.summary: Auto-caption generation module producing word-level timestamps via faster-whisper, with manual .srt fallback.

nodes.label: scene_base.html
nodes.summary: Single visual template using {CONTENT}/{ANIMATIONS}/{DUR}/{BOOK}/{GSAP_SRC} placeholders, source of all scene rendering.

nodes.label: scripts/yt-auth.mjs
nodes.summary: One-time OAuth2 flow script that produces a refresh token for headless YouTube uploads.

nodes.label: uploadToYouTube()
nodes.summary: Upload function invoked by build-chapter.js using googleapis YouTube Data API v3 + OAuth2.

nodes.label: ui/src (React dashboard)
nodes.summary: React + Vite dashboard source for visual control of config, chapters, builds, and live logs.

nodes.label: ui/index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry HTML mounting the React dashboard at #root via /src/main.tsx.

nodes.label: ui/src/main.tsx
nodes.summary: React application entry module loaded by ui/index.html.

nodes.label: Node.js 22+
nodes.summary: JavaScript runtime (Node 22+ at C:\node22) running the CommonJS pipeline.

nodes.label: npm
nodes.summary: Package manager for the root pipeline.

nodes.label: pnpm
nodes.summary: Package manager for the ui/ React dashboard.

nodes.label: Vite
nodes.summary: Frontend dev server/build tool powering the React UI dashboard.

nodes.label: React
nodes.summary: UI library used for the optional dashboard in ui/.

nodes.label: HyperFrames CLI
nodes.summary: HTML-to-video renderer invoked via npx; renders each scene HTML to MP4.

nodes.label: FFmpeg
nodes.summary: Multimedia tool for audio splitting, scene concatenation, music ducking, and thumbnail extraction.

nodes.label: FFprobe
nodes.summary: FFmpeg companion used for clean JSON duration probing of narration audio.

nodes.label: edge-tts
nodes.summary: Microsoft Edge TTS engine generating narration audio; rate flag must use equals form.

nodes.label: faster-whisper
nodes.summary: Speech-to-text engine producing word-level caption timestamps; CPU base model is slow.

nodes.label: Whisper
nodes.summary: Underlying transcription model used for auto-captions (base model on CPU).

nodes.label: GSAP
nodes.summary: GreenSock animation library driving kinetic captions and scene timeline animations.

nodes.label: googleapis
nodes.summary: Google API client providing YouTube Data API v3 + OAuth2 for uploads.

nodes.label: TTS Generation
nodes.summary: edgeTts() step producing narration.wav for the full chapter.

nodes.label: Audio Duration Probe
nodes.summary: getAudioDuration() step using ffprobe JSON output to get exact audio length.

nodes.label: Audio Split
nodes.summary: ffmpeg -ss -to step splitting narration into per-scene WAV clips.

nodes.label: Caption Generation
nodes.summary: whisper.generateCaptions() step producing scene captions.srt with manual fallback.

nodes.label: Scene HTML Build
nodes.summary: buildSceneHtml() step merging template, content, and caption JS into scene index.html.

nodes.label: Scene Render
nodes.summary: HyperFrames render step producing per-scene MP4s in parallel batches of 4.

nodes.label: Scene Concatenation
nodes.summary: ffmpeg concat step merging scene MP4s into the final chapter video.

nodes.label: Music Ducking
nodes.summary: Optional sidechaincompress mix step ducking background music under narration.

nodes.label: Thumbnail Extraction
nodes.summary: ffmpeg step extracting the frame at 2s as the video thumbnail.

nodes.label: YouTube Upload
nodes.summary: uploadToYouTube() step uploading the finished MP4 via googleapis OAuth2.

nodes.label: Parallel Render Batches
nodes.summary: Scenes rendered concurrently via Promise.all in batches of 4 to cut wall-clock time.

nodes.label: Frame-Accurate Caption Snapping
nodes.summary: Caption timestamps rounded to the nearest frame (Math.round(t/frameDur)*frameDur) to prevent drift.

nodes.label: Font/Image Pre-flight Guard
nodes.summary: document.fonts.ready + image onload gates the .ready class before HyperFrames captures, avoiding blank frames.

nodes.label: GSAP Kinetic Captions
nodes.summary: Word-by-word, frame-snapped GSAP-driven caption bar driven by the cap-bar/cap-line DOM and .word.live state.

nodes.label: Sidechain Music Ducking
nodes.summary: Background music auto-mixed with sidechaincompress ducking under narration when bg_music is set.

nodes.label: OAuth2 Refresh Flow
nodes.summary: One-time browser OAuth yielding a refresh token enabling headless YouTube uploads forever.

nodes.label: Brand Design System
nodes.summary: Visual identity spec: Space Grotesk + Inter, Hearth gold #FACC15, Midnight #0A0D16, gradient orbs, power4.out easing.

nodes.label: Animated Gradient Orbs
nodes.summary: Three blurred radial-gradient orbs (gold/violet/emerald) with screen blend forming the animated background.

nodes.label: No Stock Photos / Human Faces
nodes.summary: Visuals must be animated gradients + typography only; no stock photos or human faces.

nodes.label: Single Text Layer Per Scene
nodes.summary: Scene HTML shows visual title only; spoken words live in kinetic captions, never duplicated as body text.

nodes.label: OAuth API, Never Puppeteer
nodes.summary: YouTube uploads must use googleapis Data API v3 + OAuth2; puppeteer-based uploaders are banned.

nodes.label: Never Commit Secrets
nodes.summary: .env, OAuth tokens, and credentials must never be committed to the repo.

nodes.label: scene_base Placeholders
nodes.summary: Do not change scene_base.html structure without updating all chapter JSONs depending on its placeholders.

nodes.label: No Random in Timeline
nodes.summary: No Math.random() or Date.now() in GSAP timelines; use seeded PRNG only for determinism.

nodes.label: No CDN Dependencies
nodes.summary: GSAP source must come from config.json gsap_source, not CDN links, so one change affects all renders.

nodes.label: power4.out Easing Required
nodes.summary: Entrance animations must use power4.out/expo.out; default linear easing is forbidden.

nodes.label: ffprobe for Duration
nodes.summary: Use ffprobe clean JSON for duration probing rather than regex-parsing FFmpeg stderr.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md

nodes.summary: Runtime configuration: voice, WPM, fps, quality, canvas, bg_music, YouTube privacy.

nodes.summary: Gitignored secrets file holding YouTube OAuth client ID, secret, and refresh token.
